title: What Do Sparse Autoencoder Feature Discovery Scores Identify? From Activations to Interventions
abstract: arXiv:2610.15850v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Sparse autoencoder (SAE) features are typically discovered from how their activations co-vary with behaviour, yet they are often used through interventions such as steering or ablation. We take intervention attribution, the first-order effect of a specified intervention on the model output, as our estimand. For a broad class of response functions, we show that observational feature-discovery evidence generally does not identify this attribution, and derive an exact gradient-based decomposition of the gap between linear-probe predictions and intervention attribution. Across four model-SAE pairs, median probe-to-attribution magnitude ratios range from tens to hundreds, while attributions closely track small-step steering. For single-latent ablations with nonzero effects, gradient predictions match the realized sign in 91-97% of cases, compared with 17-35% for probe-implied changes. translated_title: 稀疏自编码器特征发现分数到底识别了什么？从激活到干预
translated_abstract: 稀疏自编码器（SAE）特征通常是根据其激活与行为如何共变而被发现的，但它们在实际中常常通过转向或消融等干预方式被使用。我们将干预归因，即特定干预对模型输出的一阶效应——作为我们的估计目标。对于一大类响应函数，我们证明观测性的特征发现证据通常无法识别这一归因，并推导出线性探针预测与干预归因之间差距的精确的基于梯度的分解。在四组模型-SAE配对中，探针与归因幅值之比的中位数从数十到数百不等，而归因则紧密跟踪小幅度的转向操作。对于具有非零效应的单潜变量消融，梯度预测在91-97%的情况下与实际效应符号一致，而探针所暗示的变化仅有17-35%一致。基于归因选择的特征集合也能产生更大的绝对……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 论文证明基于激活共变的稀疏自编码器特征发现证据通常无法预测干预（如转向或消融）的真实效果，并提出基于梯度的干预归因方法，其对消融效应符号的预测准确率达91-97%，远优于线性探针预测的17-35%。
en_tdlr: This paper proves that observational SAE feature-discovery evidence generally fails to identify intervention attribution, and proposes a gradient-based attribution method that predicts ablation effect signs in 91-97% of cases, far outperforming probe-implied changes at 17-35%.
